explain XXXXX in english without using word XXXXX

i think that the XXXXX to describe it is using a set of adjectives and also using the verb to do. i think it is better to use adjectives instead of the verb to do. let's look at the following example:

the house (to be like) is quite small.

the house (to be) is in a small building

the house (to be) is a building in a small town

the house (to be) is a small town

i think that these sentences are correct in different manners. i have also seen that if we make a verb change like i think that the house (to be) is not correct. i feel that the third one is correct.

the city (like) is beautiful.
the city (to be) is in a beautiful place
the city (to be) is beautiful in a beautiful town

in my opinion the second sentence is not correct. let's look at the following sentences:

the house in the city is beautiful.

the house (to be) in the city is beautiful, and it is in the city. i think that it is wrong.

the city (to be) is in a beautiful city,
